address: 127 Dinh Tien Hoang Street, Tan Dinh Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, 710000, Vietnam
bio: This once-humble hawker is now an iconic two-storey shop known for its delicate rice paper rolls. Made to order beside the open kitchen, they boast balanced, traditional flavours, such as pork and jicama, and vegetarian options. Be sure to try the delicious golden bean cake, a much-loved local snack.
